info.title: StockFlow API
info.description: Implemented cookie-session API. Initialize CSRF first, send cookie credentials and X-XSRF-TOKEN on mutations. Store scopes apply before aggregation and pagination. Quantities are decimal strings; dates use UTC. No bearer tokens.

parameters.description: Inclusive UTC creation-date boundary; either may be supplied alone.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

Admin/Auditor only. Non-admins see store/document events in scope and transfer events only with both stores. Global events are Admin-only.
